_about: Audit trail for the 38 flashcards in the hand-delivered CCA_TikTok_Flashcards.jsx that were NOT migrated (dedup: each is a merged restatement of 1-3 atomic cards already in the exam-prep-app corpus). Every entry maps the dropped card to the retained atomic card IDs that carry its content. tests/dropped-flashcards-audit.test.ts asserts each target exists in cards.ts AND its front contains the stated fragment, so the mapping is semantically verified, not trusted.
